entities.name: Kodama of the South Tree
entities.description: Kami of the Summer Tree in the Jukai forest, one of the Five Trees, which values community and became fierce during the Kami War.

entities.name: Summer Tree
entities.description: Tree of the Jukai whose kami is the Kodama.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which the Kodama became fierce and full of hate.

events.summary: During the Kami War, the Kodama of the South Tree becomes fierce and full of hate.
events.quote: it became fierce and full of hate during the Kami War
